data.key: Combat Trick ~ Weapon of the Chosen
data.name: Weapon of the Chosen
data.description: When using this feat, you can spend 5 stamina points to designate a weapon other than your deity's favored weapon. You gain this feat's benefits with that weapon until the start of your next turn.
